tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything, including the canvas. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Glass cards, panels, popovers. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, status colours.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, selected rows, inputs inside a card. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Decorative card and divider edge only. Never the sole boundary of a control: use `control-border`.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Border of buttons, inputs and selects. At least 3:1 on `surface` and `void` in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary labels, hints, empty-state copy on `void`, `surface`, `surface-raised`. 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Idle and thinking agents, primary buttons, scrubber fill, selected marker.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a filled `accent`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Complete state, returns, cost, added lines. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Tool calls, waiting for permission, expensive tool results. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, removed lines, unread dot. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: delegate
tokens.usage: Dispatch edges, reasoning share of context, teammate default.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: MCP tool calls and neutral informational marks.

tokens.name: context-system
tokens.usage: Fixed system overhead slice in the context bar. Non-text, 3:1 or more.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Glass card elevation. Neon adds the cyan top highlight; Graphite and Paper stay flat.
